notes: The .txt is a VTT rolling-caption dump: every line appears twice and grows. It was deduplicated (new text per caption) before reading; spot checks against the raw lines at 10:50 and 17:50 match. No chapters; all ~19.5 min covered. Run order: a Lowland game (Stone of Destiny -> an unnamed Castle landmark identified as Snowdoun Gate by '190 resource per minute' -> an unnamed Imperial landmark identified as Dhun Eideann by '100 less gold' and seven bombards), then a restart as Highlands (Abbey of the Isles -> Tower of Skye -> Three Loch Lookout). Fifteen/fifty confusion likely in two places: Tower of Skye '50%' (filled as inferred, conflicts with Beasty 15) and the Snowdoun Gate tech speed-up '50%' (unmapped). Never read here: Kirkman cost/time, Pikeman/Cateran/Gallowglass HP, Mustering Hall/Fishpond costs or HP, any build times, Highland Cattle train time.
